snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame older version playthrough - INSULTED ver. 0.02
snippet.description:
I played my own fangame! :D
Content warning:
loud noises, sudden surprises, chase scenes, flashing lights, bright colors, violence, and references to weirdcore/liminal space imagery

Read more about my fangame: https://ynfg.yume.wiki/INSULTED
Download: https://010nexus.itch.io/insulted

TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 Starting the game
1:46 Getting RAM OBJECT, Seeing Dancing with Deer EVENT, Unlocking the Computer Dream World (Must have at least 1 Object)
5:28 Getting Mouse OBJECT
7:29 Getting Speaker OBJECT
9:58 Exploring CityPNG, Visiting the Pawn Shop, Exploring the Office Building, Getting Printer OBJECT
15:58 Seeing Dark Alley Chase EVENT, Getting Monitor OBJECT, Failing a randomized chase with the Stalker
19:21 Getting Floppy Disk OBJECT
22:12 Getting AC Adapter OBJECT, Exploring PC Parts Void, Getting Power Button OBJECT, Exploring Debug World
27:07 Getting Fan OBJECT, Exploring Sands of Time, Getting Incognito OBJECT
35:29 Getting Battery OBJECT, Exploring the Warehouse, Getting Modem OBJECT
40:49 Getting Laserdisc MEDIA
44:18 Exploring Purple Apnea, Getting CD MEDIA
50:08 Exploring Silent Children's Library, Seeing Bear Hug EVENT (Required for Vinyl Media)
54:46 Exploring Thread Nation and Web of Lies, Getting Vinyl MEDIA
1:02:36 Visiting the Pawn Shop to view Media events, Seeing Vinyl EVENT
1:05:29 Seeing CD EVENT
1:08:21 Seeing Laserdisc EVENT, Seeing Hidden Room in the Pawn Shop EVENT
1:12:12 Seeing Bluescreen EVENT
1:13:08 Seeing Welcome to the World Wave Web EVENT, Exploring TicTac World
